No.513-A/12/16(3)/ESICH/TLI       Date :     .11.2026 Advertisement No.05 of 2026 Rolling advertisement for Recruitment of Full time/ Part Time Specialists, Senior Residents (3 Years) & Senior Residents (1 Year- Pay level 10) on contract basis at ESIC Hospital, Tirunelveli. WALK IN INTERVIEW In continuation of Advertisement No.04 of 2026 dated 17.10.2026 and in view of the vacancies remaining unfilled after the recruitment exercises conducted on 28.10.2026, a Rolling Advertisement is hereby issued for filling up the remaining vacancies of Full time/ Part Time Specialists, Senior Residents (3 Years) & Senior Residents (1 Year - Pay level 10) from eligible candidates on contractual basis in various departments. The Applicant/candidate should carry duly filled application form with supporting documents in original and self-attested set of documents to Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Vannarpettai, Tirunelveli for verification of documents from 9.00 AM to 10.30 AM on the date of interview, at Conference Hall, Ist Floor, ESIC Hospital, Vannarpettai, Tirunelveli. Date of Interview & Time : This is a rolling advertisement and will be applicable to fill the vacancies declared below and unfilled/fresh posts by issuing subsequent amendment notification on the website only (www.esic.gov.in) and will be valid upto 31.12.2026 or till the date of notice of closure whichever is earlier without need to re-publish in newspaper.  Walk-in-interview will be applicable for the vacancies remain available as on date of interview.  Walk-in-Interview will be held on 27.11.2026 & 16.12.2026. Vacancies available will be uploaded on website accordingly for the respective months.   
 For Sl.No.1, Priority will be given for Full Time Super Specialist/ Full Time Specialist.    
Sl.No. Details Department No. of Vacancies Category Date of Interview 1 Full Time/Part Time Specialist (i) Anaesthesiology 01 ST-01           27.11.2026 & 16.12.2026 (Registration time 9.00 a.m. to 10.30 a.m) (ii) Biochemistry 01 SC-01 (iii) Microbiology 01 SC-01 (iv) Ophthalmology 01 OBC-01 (v) General Medicine 02 OBC-01, SC-01 (vi) Orthopaedics 01 SC-01 (vii) Radiology 01 OBC-01 (viii) Accident & Emergency 01 OBC-01 (ix) Psychiatry 01 EWS-01 2    Senior Resident (03 Year)  (i) Anaesthesiology 01 EWS-01 (ii) Biochemistry 01 ST-01 (iii) Pathology 01 ST-01 (iv) Dermatology 01 EWS-01 (v) Obstetrics & Gynaecology* 06 UR-01, EWS-01, OBC-01, SC-02, ST-01 (vi) Orthopaedics 02  SC-01, ST-01 (vii) Paediatrics 02 SC-01, ST-01 (viii) Radiology 02 OBC-01, SC-01        3 Senior Resident (01 Year) at Pay level 10  (i) Accident & Emergency 03 OBC-02, SC-01 (ii) ICU 01 SC-01 Total no. of posts proposed for the engagement of contractual doctors 30

*If PG qualified doctor is not available for interview then MBBS Doctors with two years of 
experience out of which one year of experience in concerned specialty from Government hospital/ private 
hospital (not a private clinic) can be selected for 01 Year Senior Resident at Pay level 10.  
In case of non-availability of reserved candidates (SC, ST, OBC & EWS) vacancies will be filled by 
the available meritorious candidate for a period 44 days at the sole discretion of the Appointing Authority. 
Five Posts are horizontally reserved for PwBD category in identified posts. 
Only when there is no person with benchmark disability available for the post, the employer shall 
fill up the vacancy by appointment of a person, other than a person with benchmark disability, vide DoPT 
office Memorandum dated 15.01.2018.  The person who suffers from not less than 40% of disability will 
only be eligible for the benefit of reservation and other relaxations under PwBD category as permissible 
under the rule.  The applicant must have a valid Disability Certificate issued from the Competent Authority. 
Ie., Medical Board duly constituted by the Central or State Government.  Certificate issued by the Medical 
Practitioner, Hospital or any other Institution will not be considered.  The Physical disability of finally 
selected candidates would be ascertained by a Medical Board of the Institute specifically constituted for 
this purpose, if deemed necessary. 
The Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Tirunelveli reserves the right to vary these vacancies 
including increase or decrease or cancellation of filling up of any or all post without assigning any reason. 
Change in date of interview, etc, if any, will be intimated on website only.  Candidates are advised 
to check the website regularly for any updated information relating to the recruitment. 
Further details are available in our Website:  www.esic.gov.in  
 
 
 
Place : Tirunelveli       MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT I/c

Terms and conditions for Full Time Specialist 
1. The number of vacancies may be changed without any prior notice. 
2. The Full Time Specialists may be engaged on full time contract basis with consolidated remuneration for a minimum 
period of one year, extendable yearly based on satisfactory performance upto three years. 
3. No private practice will be allowed. 
4. He will be entitled for the leave @ 04 days for each month of work on pro-rata basis in a calendar year, subject to 
the applicable rules and regulations. 
5. The Full Time Specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his/her supervision in that 
specialty discipline. 
6. The selected specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period as desired by ESIC.  
The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a result of error and omissions committed by 
them while rendering professional services.  The minimum sum assured per annum should be Rs.20 Lakhs for 
General Surgeons & obstetrics, Rs.10 Lakhs for Dentist, Radiologist, Microbiologist etc., A copy of insurance 
premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement. 
7. No. TA/DA will be admissible either for the ‘Walk- in- interview’ or for joining the post. 
8. The Competent Authority reserves the right to fill up all or not to fill up any post. 
9. Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of the service in the hospital. 
10. No Hostel accommodation/quarters/uniform will be provided. 
11. The selected candidates’ will have to join within 07 days from the date of receipt of the   Selection order. 
12. The selection is subject to the candidates proving their medical fitness & verification of their Character & 
Antecedents. 
13. The appointment shall not offer any right or preference for regular appointment. 
14. In case of joining of regular candidate, the engagement shall be terminated as per the condition of the contract. 
15. No claim for any service benefits like, PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical Allowance, Seniority, Promotion and leave 
will be admissible. 
16. Candidates must be registered with Tamilnadu Medical Council or MCI before joining the post. 
17. The candidate who is in the Government Service should submit “No Objection Certificate” from the employer at 
the time of interview. 
18. Candidate seeking reservation benefits for SC/ST/OBC must ensure that they are entitled to such reservations per 
eligibility prescribed in the Notice.  They should also be in possession of the required certificates in the prescribed 
format in support of their claim as stipulated in this Notice.  OBC candidates should ensure that they are in 
possession of valid OBC Certificate issued with in the due date issued by the authority mentioned in the format. 
19. The candidate claiming reservation / age relaxation on grounds of belonging to OBC should submit the community 
Certificate in Annexure “A” prescribe vide Govt. Of India, Department of Personnel and Training OM 
No.36036/2/2013-Estt(Res). Date 30.05.2014 failing which the benefit of reservation / relaxation will not be given 
or their application shall be rejected   and    no request/ correspondence will be entertained. Certificates issued 
inother format will not be accepted and the candidates will be treated as “General Category” for all purpose.                                         
20.  The candidates are advised to bring their application/Bio data and original certificates. 
21.  All the candidates are directed to report in the office of the Medical Superintendent ESIC Hospital, Vannarpettai, 
Tirunelveli as per the timing mentioned above. 
22. The decision of the selection board will be final on all aspects of selection and no further correspondence will be 
entertained under any circumstance. 
23. The contractual appointment for full time specialist will be for one year extendable by another year, subject to 
satisfactory performance, for a maximum period of 03 years, on approval of the competent authority. 
24. The absence from work for a period of 15 days without proper permission of the Competent Authority will amount 
to abandonment of engagement and no order of disengagement shall be necessary.   
25. The candidates shall be governed by the relevant Rules and Regulations issued by the ESIC in this regard. 
26. The contractual engagement may be terminated/discontinued on either side giving one month prior notice without 
assigning reason.  Leaving the contractual services without notice period shall be dealt as per extant rules. 
27. Payment shall be made as per the instructions of the ESIC Headquarters, New Delhi from time to time. 
28. It is a contractual post for one year only and contract shall commence after submitting contract agreement signed 
on a stamp paper of Rs.100/-.  The original contract agreement will have to be submitted with the hospital.
